```{r setup}
if (basename(getwd()) == "09_reporting") setwd("..")

library(dplyr)
library(gt)
library(baseballr)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(purrr)

# ── Load pipeline cache ──────────────────────────────────────
cache_path <- "data/pipeline_cache.rds"
cache_ok   <- file.exists(cache_path) &&
              difftime(Sys.time(), file.mtime(cache_path), units = "hours") < 12
if (cache_ok) {
  cache <- readRDS(cache_path)
  list2env(cache, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  rm(cache)
} else {
  invisible(capture.output(source("run_pipeline_phase01.R")))
}

# ── Load helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────
source("09_reporting/_series_helpers.R")

# ── Series context ───────────────────────────────────────────
if (!exists("braves_series_context") || is.null(braves_series_context$current_series)) {
  stop("No current series context found. Run the daily pipeline first.")
}

cs <- braves_series_context$current_series
```

```{r series-result-header}
#| output: asis
# Fetch boxscore data for all games
recap_data <- make_series_recap_boxscores(cs)

result_label <- if (!is.null(recap_data)) recap_data$result_header else
  paste0("Atlanta Braves vs ", cs$opponent_name)

series_dates <- if (length(cs$game_dates) > 1) {
  paste0(format(min(cs$game_dates), "%b %d"), " \u2013 ",
         format(max(cs$game_dates), "%b %d, %Y"))
} else {
  format(cs$game_dates[1], "%B %d, %Y")
}

braves_won <- !is.null(recap_data) && recap_data$braves_wins > recap_data$opp_wins
result_color <- if (!is.null(recap_data)) {
  if (recap_data$braves_wins > recap_data$opp_wins) "#27ae60"
  else if (recap_data$opp_wins > recap_data$braves_wins) "#e74c3c"
  else "#f39c12"
} else "#7f8c8d"

cat(paste0(
  '<div style="background:', result_color, ';color:white;padding:20px 24px;',
  'border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:1.5rem;">',
  '<div style="font-size:0.8rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:1px;',
  'opacity:0.85;margin-bottom:6px;">Series Recap</div>',
  '<div style="font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px;">',
  result_label, '</div>',
  '<div style="font-size:0.9rem;opacity:0.9;">', series_dates,
  ' &nbsp;&middot;&nbsp; ', cs$venue_name, '</div>',
  '</div>'
), "\n\n")
```

## Game-by-Game Results

```{r boxscores}
#| output: asis
if (is.null(recap_data) || is.null(recap_data$table_data)) {
  cat("*Game results not yet available.*\n\n")
} else {
  tbl <- recap_data$table_data %>%
    dplyr::select(Game, Date, Score, Winner) %>%
    gt::gt() %>%
    gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = -c(Game, Date)) %>%
    gt::cols_align(align = "left",   columns = c(Game, Date)) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
      style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = gt::cells_body(
        columns = Winner,
        rows    = Winner == "Atlanta Braves"
      )
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
      style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#eafaf1"),
      locations = gt::cells_body(rows = Winner == "Atlanta Braves")
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_style(
      style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#fdedec"),
      locations = gt::cells_body(rows = Winner != "Atlanta Braves" & Winner != "—")
    ) %>%
    gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "\u2014") %>%
    gt::tab_options(
      table.font.size      = 13,
      data_row.padding     = gt::px(8),
      column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
    ) %>%
    gt::opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")

  cat(gt::as_raw_html(tbl), "\n\n")
}
```

## Individual Game Deep Dives

*Full play-by-play analysis for each game in this series:*

```{r game-links}
#| output: asis
away_abbr_str <- tryCatch({
  team_ids %>% dplyr::filter(mlbam_team_id == cs$away_team_id) %>%
    dplyr::pull(team_abbr) %>% dplyr::first()
}, error = function(e) "AWAY")
home_abbr_str <- tryCatch({
  team_ids %>% dplyr::filter(mlbam_team_id == cs$home_team_id) %>%
    dplyr::pull(team_abbr) %>% dplyr::first()
}, error = function(e) "HOME")
away_abbr_str <- if (is.na(away_abbr_str) || length(away_abbr_str) == 0) "AWAY" else away_abbr_str
home_abbr_str <- if (is.na(home_abbr_str) || length(home_abbr_str) == 0) "HOME" else home_abbr_str

links <- purrr::map_chr(seq_along(cs$game_pks), function(i) {
  gdate <- format(cs$game_dates[i], "%Y-%m-%d")
  fname <- paste0("deepdive_", gdate, "_", away_abbr_str, "_", home_abbr_str, ".html")
  paste0(
    '<a href="', fname, '" style="display:inline-block;background:#1a73e8;color:white;',
    'padding:6px 14px;border-radius:4px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;margin:4px;">',
    'Game ', i, ' \u2014 ', format(cs$game_dates[i], "%b %d"), '</a>'
  )
})

cat(paste0(
  '<div style="margin:1rem 0;">',
  paste(links, collapse = "\n"),
  '</div>'
), "\n\n")
```
